manifest.stage_name_fa: ساخت سیستم مرور اشتباهات و Error Review

governance.authoritative_book: Grammaire Progressive du Français - Niveau intermédiaire - 3e édition

goal_fa: تبدیل پاسخ‌های غلط به تجربه آموزشی قابل جست‌وجو، فیلتر، گروه‌بندی و تکرار که علت خطا را نشان می‌دهد و بدون تغییر آمار آزمون اصلی الگوهای misconception را آشکار می‌کند.

roadmap_outputs.mistake_grouping: MISCONCEPTION first; stable SUBTOPIC_UNMAPPED fallback when no mapped misconception exists

source_contract.unscorable_policy: is_correct=null never creates an error review item
source_contract.question_revision: use exact frozen Stage13 test_questions snapshot for history and retry; never silently swap to a newer revision
source_contract.misconception_source: selected distractor option misconception_id from Stage7/Stage12
source_contract.retired_policy: retain history; exact retired/disabled revision becomes HISTORY_ONLY and is not retried
source_contract.content_issue_policy: confirmed ambiguity/invalid content is EXCLUDED_CONTENT_ISSUE, HISTORY_ONLY, and creates a learning-evidence exclusion event

grouping.fallback_semantics: data-quality fallback only; does not invent a misconception
grouping.repeat_count: count of eligible original wrong-answer review items in the group; review retry failures do not inflate original mistake count
grouping.group_resolution: UNRESOLVED if any active item unresolved; else CORRECTED if any corrected item; else EXCLUDED_CONTENT_ISSUE

retrieval_practice.explicit_reveal_without_retry: allowed but audited as ANSWER_REVEALED and does not resolve the item

statistics_and_mastery_boundary.original_test_stats: immutable; review events never update test_attempts score or source user_answers
statistics_and_mastery_boundary.stage15_mastery: review retries are resolution evidence, not mastery evidence in v0.9; no hidden change to Stage15 formula
statistics_and_mastery_boundary.content_issue_correction: learning-evidence exclusion events gate the affected source answer out of future Stage15 mastery replay; raw answer remains auditable
statistics_and_mastery_boundary.stage17_srs: Stage16 records review outcomes/marks only; it does not calculate interval_days, due_at, strength, or scheduler_version

failure_contract.action: fail closed; do not serve review session
data integrity failure; no grouping guess
data integrity failure; no implicit difficulty mapping
show historical record only; do not accept retry
normal empty state; suggest regular/adaptive practice, not fabricated review items

risk_controls.preventive: misconception grouping + deterministic default priority + filters
risk_controls.detection: monitor unresolved groups/items and p95 queue size

risk_controls.preventive: feedback hidden until retry or explicit audited reveal

risk_controls.detection: alert if confirmed ambiguous source answer remains mastery-eligible

risk_controls.preventive: Stage16 does not self-schedule; history-only safety gate and stable grouping
risk_controls.detection: monitor same-question review count and hand off interval policy to Stage17

risk_controls.preventive: explicit SUBTOPIC_UNMAPPED fallback, never invented diagnosis
risk_controls.detection: monitor unmapped_group_share; block misleading misconception label

stage25: review event retention and user-history privacy policy
